deadline.value: December 1 for Fall 2027, international and Canadian applicants.
deadline.quote: Application Deadline - International | FALL September 15 December 1 December 1

supervisor.value: You may name preferred supervisors in the application; the pages don't say an agreement is needed first.
supervisor.quote: Applicants to the Ph.D. program may specify, in their application, their preferred area(s) of research and/or preferred supervisor(s).

funding.value: The department's pages give no funding guarantee.

entry_route.value: A master's in engineering or physical sciences (CGPA 3.3) is required; the course catalogue allows direct entry only in exceptional cases.
entry_route.quote: Applicants to the Ph.D. program must have successfully completed a Master's degree program, or the equivalent, in Engineering or the Physical Sciences, with a minimum CGPA equivalent to 3.3 on a scale of 4.0. | Students are not admitted directly from an undergraduate program.

also.quote: In exceptional circumstances, students with outstanding performance at the bachelor's level may be offered direct entry into the Ph.D. program (Ph.D. 1).
